answer: LIST street, city, zip, state FROM Satscore has SatscoreNumGE1500 g AND ALSO has SatscoreNumTstTakr t AND ALSO has SchoolStreet street AND ALSO has SchoolCity city AND ALSO has SchoolZip zip AND ALSO has SchoolState state AND ALSO (g / t) AS rate ORDERED WITH rate ASCENDING THE FIRST 1
LIST n FROM Frpm [has SchoolDOC: 31] has FrpmSchoolName n AND ALSO has FrpmEnrollmentK12 k ORDERED WITH k DESCENDING THE FIRST 1
LIST g FROM School has SchoolGSoffered g AND ALSO has SchoolLongitude lon ORDERED WITH abs(lon) DESCENDING THE FIRST 1

LIST n, doc FROM Frpm [has FrpmCharterFundingType: 'Locally funded'] has FrpmSchoolName n AND ALSO has SchoolDOCType doc AND ALSO has FrpmEnrollmentK12 k AND ALSO has FrpmEnrollmentAges517 a WHERE (k - a) > THE AVERAGE d IN (Frpm [has FrpmCharterFundingType: 'Locally funded'] has FrpmEnrollmentK12 k2 AND ALSO has FrpmEnrollmentAges517 a2 AND ALSO (k2 - a2) AS d)
LIST n FROM School has FrpmSchoolName n AND ALSO has FrpmFreeMealCountK12 f AND ALSO has FrpmEnrollmentK12 k AND ALSO has SatscoreNumGE1500 g WHERE (f / k) > 0.1 AND g >= 1
LIST c, cnt FROM School s [has SchoolVirtual: 'F'] has SchoolCounty c AND ALSO THE COUNT OF s GROUPED BY c AS cnt WHERE c = 'San Diego' OR c = 'Santa Barbara' ORDERED WITH cnt DESCENDING THE FIRST 1
